product.title: Early morning Chichen Itza Tour: Cenote and Tequila Tasting

description.text: In Cancun, say goodbye to the Riviera Maya beaches and see a different side of the Yucatan. This guided tour explores Chichen Itza’s pyramid temples and colonial Valladolid, with a swim in an underground cenote. Stops include Chichen Itza, Cenote, Valladolid. Upgrade to add transfers from Cancun or Riviera Maya hotels—or book a private tour with flexible pickup times. Ideal for visitors basing in Cancun who want a guided city experience without coordinating bus and walking routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Chichen Itza, Cenote, Valladolid that define this Cancun sightseeing experience, with a guide handling hotel pickup, ruin tickets, and cenote or island pacing so the day stays focused on the outing rather than logistics.

highlights: Discover the Yucatan's rich history, both Mayan and colonial Spanish
Enjoy a guided tour of Chichen Itza, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Feast on a delicious buffet lunch—and taste tequila, too
Upgrade to add hotel transfers or a guide and vehicle just for your group

start.description: We offer convenient pickup services from the majority of hotels situated in the hotel zones of Cancun and Riviera Maya, or alternatively, we can arrange a meeting point near your specific hotel in Cancun, Riviera Maya, Playa del Carmen, and Tulum.

end.description: Return to your Cancun meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
